text_block_list.text:
One day as summer camp is winding
down...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Oh, Flaaash! ☆ There you are!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Falcon?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон, Эйсин Флэш's roommate
and
self-proclaimed Umadol, runs up to
us cheerfully.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
You were searching for me? Did you
need me for
something?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: Ehehe! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I set aside twenty-five milliliters of tail

conditioner for you.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Thanks a bunch! ☆ Now my tail'll be
silky smooth!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: I believe I reminded you to check your baggage on two separate occasions before we departed for camp.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Yeaaah, but I just knew you'd bring
extra,
sooo... ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Actually, we could just shower together.
It's
pretty late already.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I can't. I have yet to complete my
training. There
are still fifteen... no,
twenty minutes including
transit time
before I'm done.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Aw, come on! Who cares about skipping
twenty
minutes of practice?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Falcon. Skipping five minutes of practice
is still
within acceptability, but skipping
twenty minutes
is highly irresponsible
and—
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
There you go again with your
fancy-schmancy
words and stuff!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I don't believe I have said anything
particularly
"fancy-schmancy"...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш isn't usually so emotive. She
must be
comfortable enough with Smart
Falcon to let her
guard down.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Let's head back, Trainer. I'd like to
receive your
feedback for today's
session and verify the
details of
tomorrow's schedule.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Ugh, I can't believe you're still going on
about
that stuff! Just do it tomorrow.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш is getting stronger by the
day, but I
think she'll need to approach
things from a new
angle if she wants to
get stronger still.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's been going all-out from the day
camp
started, but if there's one way to
get her to
relax...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
choice_data_list: Can I ask you a few questions, Смарт Фалкон?

text_block_list.text: Huh? Sure. About what?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: How do you hold out during races?

text_block_list.text:
It takes a lot of power to run on dirt
tracks, which
is where Смарт Фалкон
thrives. I ask her to give us
some
pointers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Indeed, I could learn much from you
about
strength, Falcon.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Your dancing is forceful enough to bring
things
tumbling down in the dorm room,
after all.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Was that supposed to be a compliment?
Anyway,
let's see... My strength, huh?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Oh, I've got it! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Yuuum! ♪ That cotton candy was
delish! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
So what's next? Toffee? Candied
apples?
Everything's sooo cute! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. I thought you were going to
tell us
your technique for building
strength.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
So why are we at a summer festival
perusing all
the desserts from the street
stalls?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Chowing down on sweet stuff is the best
way to
recharge yourself! ☆ It's my
tried-and-true secret
to gaining
power! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Does it?
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш
choice_data_list: Just give it a try and have fun!

text_block_list.text:
How am I supposed to "give it a try and
have fun"
when there's no way to
validate Falcon's claims?
For starters—
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Okay, no more fancy-schmancy words or
logic
from you! ☆ C'mon and let's go!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Смарт Фалкон is an incredible front
runner, and
I've always wondered how
she manages to stay
ahead of the pack
in her races.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Indeed... I could learn much from you
about
tenacity, Falcon.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
You even extend the riverside concerts
you hold
by an extra song when you
notice a new audience
member join the
crowd.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Hehehe! ☆ That's something my fans
always give
me brownie points for!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Well, if you really wanna know how I'm
able to
work so hard, it's...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: L-O-V-E! Love ☆ Falco! Lemme hear it!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Love ☆ Falco!
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Incredible. Falcon has been dancing
continuously
for over an hour...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
I love you all, my fans! ☆ As long as you
have
your eyes on me, I can go on
forever!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: And today's fan of the day is... Flash!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I was so touched that you knew about
the
concerts I hold by the river! Thanks
for looking
out for me all the time!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Now let me channel all my feelings of
gratitude
into this next song! ☆ Let's
gooo!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Feelings and emotions... They're such
ambiguous
things, but somehow she
manages to convey them
so clearly.
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text: She really is amazing...
text_block_list.name: Эйсин Флэш

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш is skeptical at first, but she
does
seem to look more refreshed and
energetic in the
end.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Эйсин Флэш says this last part softly, but
it's
impossible to miss the fondness in
her words.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
